name: Inran Mahjong ~Nugasare Modaeru Maid-tachi~
original_name: 淫乱麻雀 ～脱がされ悶えるメイド達～
source:
Main character decides to hire a new maid. But there are six candidates, so wants to make a decision through playing mahjong with each of them. It's not important for the girl to win in such game, but it's much more important to lose spectacularly and accept the punishment game...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
